parallels.note: “ ‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

people.name: Mallothi
people.line: Son of Heman, a musician in David's court.

translations.web: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translations.bsb: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
translations.kjv: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
